artworks.title: Le Christ portant sa croix (5e planche) (Christ Carrying the Cross) (fifth plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print of a person carrying a large wooden cross through a crowd. The print is composed of thin lines and scribbles. The central person is depicted bending forward under the weight of the large, T-shaped cross. They have long, dark hair covering their face, and wear a draped garment. The background features a crowd of numerous onlookers, depicted with thin, crossing lines and few details. We can only see features of a few of them. The background is made of thin vertical and horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Lourdes, transport des paralysées (Lourdes, Transport of the Paralyzed)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures in various poses within a crowd. The central figure is holding an unfolded object, surrounded by other figures including one kneeling with raised arms and another figure lying on the ground. Additional figures in the background suggest an event or gathering. The scene is depicted using fine sketch-like lines to convey movement and emotion in a busy atmosphere. The figures are portrayed with minimal detail, emphasizing the abstract representation of their actions and interactions.

artworks.title: Les notables (petite planche) (The Notables) (small plate)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a print showing a group of people in a line moving to the right. The people are standing, with one adult bending slightly over two children, holding their shoulders. One man behind this adult seems to point a gun towards them. The facial features of the people are minimal, with simple expressions and various hairstyles. The individuals wear long, flowing robes, and some appear to be holding more weapons. The background is minimal, leaving the focus on the group.

artworks.title: Les notables (grande planche) (The Notables) (large plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of several figures in motion. The image captures a dynamic scene with figures shown mid-motion. 

One figure is leaning forward as if running, depicted with bold lines suggesting rapid movement. They are wearing loose clothing and a hat that implies a specific context. 

Nearby, a group of figures are close together, potentially comforting each other or moving in solidarity. The drawing uses cross-hatching and delicate lines to create depth and emotion. 

Overall, the sketch portrays movement, urgency, and community through expressive pencil strokes, blending realism with abstraction.

artworks.title: La route d'Emmaüs (2e planche) (The Road to Emmaus) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This print is a faint depiction of two or three people standing side by side. They appear to gesture or reach towards each other. The person in the center appears to be crouching down, supported by the person on the right who seems to hold a long, thin object resembling a staff. The people appear to have shoulder-length, flowing hair and are wearing loose-fitting garments. Their details and facial features are hard to identify due to the faint lines, and there could be a third person between them, although the shapes are ambiguous. The background features darker, swirling lines in the sky.

artworks.title: The Miracle before the Blessed Sacrament (fourth plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a religious monstrance surrounded by other figures in a state of prayer or reverence in a crowded space with indistinct figures lying and sitting. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth, focusing on spirituality and the comfort of faith in times of illness.

artworks.title: Le repos en Egypte (The Rest in Egypt)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This print is a sketch-like depiction of three people who appear to be seated outdoors. On the left is a person with short hair who has their back to us. They are depicted in thin, pale-gray lines. On the right is another person with a shawl around their head who sits cross-legged, holding a small baby. This person is depicted in darker lines with sections of crosshatching. Both adults are leaning their heads in towards the baby. On the right is a basket on the ground, surrounded by other indistinct objects. The background is empty, off-white paper.

artworks.title: Le retour au foyer (The Return Home)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures carrying bags. The central aspect is a group of three figures sketched with fine lines, suggesting movement as they carry large, cylindrical bags. They are dressed in simple garments and appear to be on a journey. The backdrop consists of faint outlines, potentially indicating a landscape or settlement. The artist's technique uses delicate, cross-hatched lines to create depth and shadow, giving texture and dimension to the figures and environment. The drawing's composition and use of space convey resilience and determination.

artworks.title: Portrait de Forain (Portrait of Forain)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile from the shoulders up. He is turned slightly towards the viewer, with his face and the brim of his hat visible. The man has a pronounced nose, furrowed brow, and a focused gaze. His hair is concealed under the hat. He wears a cloak or coat with loose lines. There is no visible jewelry or objects, and the background is shaded, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Forain gravant (1ère planche) (Forain Etching) (first plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person sitting at a table, leaning forward with their head almost resting on an open book. The individual's facial features are drawn with a thoughtful expression, and they have short, dark hair covering part of their forehead. They are wearing a long-sleeved garment. The background consists of loosely sketched lines indicating a large window or frame on the wall behind the person.

artworks.title: J.L. Forain
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile drawing of a person's upper body. The person is seated and leans forward, with their right arm bent on a surface. They have defined facial features, wear spectacles, a bowler hat, and formal attire with a jacket and tie. In one hand, they hold or point to a book or paper with abstract sketches. The background consists of crosshatched lines for texture.

artworks.title: Lourdes, transport des paralysées (Lourdes, Transport of the Paralyzed)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate scene with multiple figures in various poses and activities. The sketch captures a moment in time with loose and gestural lines. One figure is standing in the foreground wearing a hat and holding another figure, while another figure is kneeling with an outstretched arm. The background is filled with additional figures, outlined in a rough manner, creating a crowded setting that implies a social or historical context. The artist utilized cross-hatching and minimal lines to convey depth and movement, resulting in an expressive and dynamic image.

artworks.title: Déclaration d'amour (Declaration of Love)
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a faint sketch featuring the upper bodies of two people positioned closely together. The person on the left appears to be a man with a mustache and bald head, wearing a suit or jacket. His facial features are indistinct. The person on the right is likely female with a clearer facial profile and hair styled up or back. Their clothing is softly detailed, blending into the background. The background is undefined with simple curtain-like elements or vertical lines. The sketch is on a textured surface with minimal detail, and no distinct objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Mlle Bécat
artworks.medium: monotype on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a partially visible person's upper body in an indistinct seated or standing posture with bent arms. The facial features are vague, and there is long hair falling down the sides. The person is wearing a long garment, and the background consists of abstract light and dark areas with vertical brushstroke-like markings on the sides. There are no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: Le Christ portant sa croix (7e planche) (Christ Carrying the Cross) (seventh plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an individual carrying a large cross surrounded by a group of people. The artwork features intricate line work giving it a textured appearance. In the foreground, the central figure is shown struggling under the weight of the cross. The background shows a gathering of figures, some less defined, adding depth to the composition. The use of light and shadow is achieved through cross-hatching, creating contrast. The monochromatic palette and sketch-like quality suggest a moment frozen in time, emphasizing the emotional and physical intensity in the scene.

artworks.title: Lourdes, la miraculée (1ère planche) (Lourdes, the Miracle) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts numerous figures in a crowded scene, with a central person standing with hands clasped together. This individual appears more prominent and has long hair, wearing a long flowing garment. Surrounding figures are in various poses, with some kneeling or crouching. The background is minimally detailed, and the image has a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Le miraculé devant l'ostensoir (4e planche) (The Miracle before the Blessed Sacrament) (fourth plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene involving a priest and several figures. The drawing depicts a central figure, presumably a priest, holding a large, ornate object that resembles a monstrance, while another figure stands to the right. In the background, there are multiple figures lying on beds or pallets. The drawing is rendered with loose, expressive lines, giving the scene a sense of movement and emotion. The style suggests a focus on conveying the solemnity and gravity of the moment depicted.

artworks.title: Pèlerins d'Emmaüs (Pilgrims at Emmaus)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and white and brown wash with graphite additions on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures seated around a table. The person on the left has dark, short hair and wears a dark garment. The central figure has long hair, a beard, and rests their arm on the table, wearing a light-colored garment. The person on the right has a bald head with hair on the sides and wears a coat. The setting is indoors, with blurred and sketchy background details and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Au restaurant (At the Restaurant)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting at separate tables. The man on the left wears a top hat, suit, bow tie, vest, and has a moustache. He looks slightly to the left. The woman at the right table leans her chin on her hand, with her arm bent, looking towards the right. She has curly hair and wears a hat with feathers, a dress with puffed sleeves, and long gloves. The man's table has bottles and a book, while the woman's table has a plate. They are in a restaurant or café setting with light from a window in the background, and sketched lines indicating walls or a partition.

artworks.title: Danseuse rattachant son chausson (Dancer Tying Her Slipper)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman in a ballet tutu adjusting her ballet shoe. Beside her, on a chair, is another piece of clothing or shawl. In the background, another woman stands behind a dressing screen, holding a piece of fabric. The room is minimally furnished, with framed artwork on the wall.

artworks.title: Une saisie (A Seizure)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two characters in an interior setting with a rich interplay of light and shadow. The scene depicts an exchange or interaction happening between the two individuals. The figure on the left is dressed in a long coat and top hat, carrying a portfolio, while leaning forward with a serious expression. The figure on the right is dressed in undergarments, standing with their back turned towards the viewer. This creates a sense of narrative tension and intrigue about the nature of their interaction. The background features sketchy lines, adding depth and focus to the central figures. The use of charcoal or pencil creates a monochromatic effect, emphasizing the texture and emotions conveyed in the composition.

artworks.title: Rue Laffitte (Laffitte Street)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two figures in a room as part of a lithograph. On the left, there is a person facing forward with neutral expression, aged features, dark hair under a black scarf, and dark clothing. On the right, there is a person in profile leaning forward holding a framed picture, wearing a cap, facial hair, and a jacket. The background hints at interior furnishings, emphasizing the framed picture. The illustration is minimally detailed, focusing on the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: "J'ose pas encore aller le décrocher...ça lui fera trop de peine." ("I don't dare take them down...it would hurt him too much.")
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing in close proximity. On the left, a man is depicted in a slight profile view, looking towards the woman. He has a robust build, a mustache, and wears a cap. He is holding a rectangular object close to his body. On the right, a woman is shown in profile facing the man. She has long, wavy hair and wears a long dress with a high collar. The background consists of soft, sketchy lines hinting at walls or shelves with a silhouetted figure in the background on the right.

artworks.title: a) Au théâtre (At the Theatre) (recto); (b) Untitled (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) lithograph on wove Arches vellum paper
b) crayon in purple on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a theater box. In the center, there is an older man with a mustache, wearing a top hat and a formal suit with a bow tie. To his right, a woman with long, dark hair sits. Beside them, there is another male figure with a bald head. In the foreground, there are more seats, and in the background, there are darker shadowy figures. The scene has a sketch-like quality with soft, blurred details and a monochrome color palette.
